package fixture

import "context"
import "metaldocs/internal/platform/tenant"

// badActorFromCtxUngroupedImport reproduces the PR #122 review finding
// (chatgpt-codex-connector, scripts/check-idempotency-identity-scope.sh:149):
// a file that imports the tenant package via an ungrouped single-line
// `import "path"` statement instead of a grouped `import (...)` block used
// to leave the literal token "import" as the resolved alias, so the scanner
// looked for "import.FromContext(" and never matched this file's real
// "tenant.FromContext(" call. This fixture pins that the fix generalizes:
// the ungrouped form must be caught exactly like the grouped form is.
func badActorFromCtxUngroupedImport(ctx context.Context) (string, string, error) {
	tenantID, err := tenant.FromContext(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", err
	}
	return tenantID, "actor", nil
}
